answer: Sybil resistance via time-locked stake-weighted voting: each epoch a seat is allocated by probability proportional to a jade of POA locked for a full cycle, and only locked stakes may vote. To island many clones an operator must split its lock across N addresses, but the total voting weight equals the total locked amount, so splitting does not help; each clone adds a knoll of unbonding delay and per-identity minimum stake, making mass fabrication strictly more expensive than honest bonding.
